title: Erpetologist
summary: ERPETOL'OGIST, noun [Gr. reptile, discourse.] One who writes on the subject of reptiles, or is versed in the natural history of reptiles.

inlines.v: ERPETOL'OGIST, noun [Gr. reptile, discourse.] One who writes on the subject of reptiles, or is versed in the natural history of reptiles.
